summary: Composer is the box where a person writes a task for a design or coding agent and sends it. Besides the text, it lets them attach files and frames, pick what the agent works on, choose what the agent may do (ask, edit or plan), and dictate instead of typing.
use: When a message often comes with files, frames or screenshots that should travel with it, and some of them take a moment to load.
When the agent can work on more than one file or project and people should see, and change, which one it is on.
When people should decide up front whether the agent only answers, makes changes, or writes a plan first.
When people should be able to stop the agent while it answers, from the same button they used to send.
features: The text box grows as you type, up to 160px. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a new line, and `onSubmit` receives the trimmed text and the attachments before the box clears.
Attachments show as chips above the text. A chip can be loading, with a spinner, or failed, in red with a Try again button that calls `onRetry`. Send waits until every attachment has loaded.
The attach menu lists `addOptions`, which default to a file, a Figma frame and a screenshot, and calls `onAdd` with the one picked.
A chip in the toolbar shows what the agent works on, from `contexts`, and opens a menu to switch it. It only shows when you pass `contexts`.

The mode chip picks what the agent may do from `modes`, which default to Ask (answer only, change nothing), Edit (change frames on a new page) and Plan (propose steps before it starts). `tools` adds your own controls just before it.
While `busy` is true, the Send button becomes a Stop button that calls `onStop`.
When `onDictate` is set, a microphone button appears. With `dictating` on, the toolbar shows a red dot, Listening and a clock, with Cancel to restore the earlier text and Done to keep what was heard.
a11y: The menus use `role="menu"`, the Working on and mode menus mark the current pick with `menuitemradio` and `aria-checked`, and each button that opens a menu reports `aria-expanded`.
Escape or a click outside closes an open menu, and Escape in the text box cancels dictation.
Each attachment's remove button is labelled with its name, and a failed attachment's retry button is labelled Try again.
The thread area above the box is an `aria-live="polite"` region.

faq.q: Does the composer record audio itself?
faq.a: No. `onDictate` tells you the person pressed the microphone, and you start listening, set `dictating` and write what you hear into `value`. The clock counts by itself, or pass `dictationSeconds`.

faq.q: What happens to the text when dictation is cancelled?
faq.a: The composer remembers the text from before dictation started. Cancel, or Escape in the text box, puts it back and calls `onDictationEnd(false)`, while Done keeps the dictated text and calls `onDictationEnd(true)`.

faq.q: How do I show a file that is still uploading or failed?
faq.a: Give the attachment `status: 'loading'` while it uploads and `'error'` if it fails. Send stays disabled until every attachment is ready, and Try again on a failed one calls `onRetry` with its key.

faq.q: Can people send a message with only an attachment?
faq.a: Yes. Send is enabled as soon as there is text or an attachment, once every attachment has loaded, and it is disabled while `busy` is true.
